svg.text: The question funnel: wide to narrow

g.text: OPEN — "tell me about…"
stories, feelings, their words
PROBE — "help me understand…"
gently deeper, one thread
CLOSED — "how many…? when…?"
facts, numbers, checks
FUNNEL ORDER: open first (their story!) → probe gently (one thread!) → closed last
(facts!). Reversed funnels (20 closed questions first) interrogate; funnels HEAR. Ratio aim:
70% open/probe, 30% closed — emergencies excepted.
OPENERS: "tell me about…", "what's it like…?", "how has…?", "what matters most…?". PROBES:
"help me understand…", "say more about…", "what was the hardest part…?". CLOSED: "how
many stools? what time? which leg? on a scale 0–10…?" — facts that focus care.
BANNED (exam traps!): LEADING ("you took your drugs, right?" — coerces lies!) · MULTIPLE
("pain? fever? appetite? bowels?" — pick ONE!) · WHY-BOMBS ("why did you default?!" —
accuses! → "what made it hard to come?" heals!) · JARGON ("describe your micturition" —
"how is passing urine?" works!) · DOUBLE-NEGATIVES ("you don't not want…?" — huh?).
SCALE QUESTIONS: "pain 0–10?" · "worry 0–10?" · "confidence taking meds 0–10?" — numbers
track change + open talk ("a 7! what would make it a 5?"). Miracle question (solution talk):
"if tonight fixed one thing, what'd morning look like?" — reveals TRUE goals.
CHILDREN: one question + play + parent-triangulate (M05!). ELDERS: slow + loud-clear + one
at a time (GER!). LANGUAGE GAPS: short + interpreter + teach-back (M05!).
LINKS: M02 feelings-first · NUT diet histories · INF PICO asking.
MANTRA: "open the door, follow one thread, count last."
